chapters.title: Eight links. One arm.
chapters.copy: A real open-source robot, held in its original assembled pose.

chapters.title: The chain opens.
chapters.copy: Four link groups separate on the beat. Their source hierarchy stays intact.

chapters.title: From reach to orientation.
chapters.copy: The wrist connects the arm to the gripper carriage.

chapters.title: Two jaws, one grasp.
chapters.copy: The source describes opposed sliding jaws. Here, they separate for inspection.

chapters.title: Every link returns.
chapters.copy: The sequence reverses: jaws, wrist, forearm, shoulder. No source pose is rewritten.

chapters.title: Whole again.
chapters.copy: The original assembly is restored. The score and the view return to the beginning.
